Name: Uzza, Driver of the Ark
Summary: Of the house of Abinadab, who drove the cart bearing the ark and died when he put forth his hand to hold the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 13:7; 1 Chronicles 13:9; 1 Chronicles 13:10: Of the house of Abinadab, who drove the cart bearing the ark and died when he put forth his hand to hold the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Uzza in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
